review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Structural Immunology of Complement Receptors 3 and 4, PMID:30534123
primary_title: Distinct recognition of complement iC3b by integrins alphaXbeta2 and alphaMbeta2
decision_basis: The integrin review identifies iC3b as a ligand for alphaMbeta2/CR3 and cites primary structural-biochemical work showing direct iC3b recognition by the intact alphaMbeta2 headpiece at distinct sites.
limitations_preserved: Restrict promotion to processed iC3b direct recognition by the Mac-1 heterodimer; phagocytosis is contextual opsonized-target biology, not an autonomous free-C3 claim, and no SCI inference is added.
